title.zh: Stripe计划将稳定币卡业务扩展至全球，目标年底覆盖逾100个国家
title.en: Stripe计划将稳定币卡业务扩展至全球，目标年底覆盖逾100个国家

current_state.zh: Stripe is taking its stablecoin card business global, targeting coverage in more than 100 countries by the end of the year, with existing clients including Kraken, Ramp and Morse, and Privy co-founder Henri Stern now overseeing Stripe's stablecoin and crypto operations.
current_state.en: Stripe is taking its stablecoin card business global, targeting coverage in more than 100 countries by the end of the year, with existing clients including Kraken, Ramp and Morse, and Privy co-founder Henri Stern now overseeing Stripe's stablecoin and crypto operations.
